name: skyglance-spotter
description: Ask Claude what's flying above you: live aircraft with where to look in the sky, aircraft identity, routes, photos, viewing conditions, and an optional local history of everything that's passed over. Free public ADS-B data, no API keys.

home_lat.title: Home latitude
home_lat.description: Optional. Your latitude, e.g. 40.71, so you can ask "what's over me" without saying where you are. Leave empty to give a location each time.

record_history.title: Record sighting history
record_history.description: Off by default. When on (and a home location is set), SkyGlance checks your sky about once a minute while Claude is running and keeps a local history of passing aircraft on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
